title: Forum, Thread, Post & Reply
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 1 Week 4 Study sheet pp.19-22, Classwork, Homework

scenes.t: An online discussion forum is like a big message board on the internet. People post questions, share answers and talk about topics they like.
A thread is one conversation about a specific topic inside the forum. A thread can have many posts.
The topic is the main subject of the post.
A post is a message that you share in the discussion.
An attachment is a file that you add to a post. It can be a document, an image or a video.
A comment is a response to a post. To reply means to answer directly to a comment from another person.
To embed means to put a video or a picture inside your post, so it plays right there.
To start a discussion: open the forum, choose a topic, click Create thread, then type your message and post it.
